question: LakshyaSen was born in ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Uttarakhand.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lakshya Sen was born on** August 16, 2001; Almora, Uttarakhand, India**.
 
• He is a famous **Badminton Player**.
 
• He got recognition after winning **Asian Junior Championship 2016**.
 
• He further won **Youth Olympics 2018, Scottish Open 2019 Dutch Open 2019 and Bronze medal in World Championship 2021.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Badminton is a sport played with racquet, shuttlecock and a net, in singles (one player per side) or doubles (two players per side) formats. 
 
• The dimensions of court are
 
 
• **13.4 meters long and 5.18 meters** wide for singles.
 
• **13.4 meters long and 6.1 meters** wide for doubles.
 
• The net **height is 1.55 meters at the edges and 1.524 meters at the cente**r (for both).
 
 
 
• Some important tournaments are: **Olympic Games, BWF World Championships, All England Open Badminton Championships, Thomas Cup, Uber Cup, Sudirman Cup**.
 
• 
 
Important Terms in Badminton: **Shuttlecock/Shuttle, Racquet, Net, Serve, Clear, Drop Shot, Smash, Drive, Net-Shot, Rally, Deception, Fault, Lift, Backhand, Forehand, Footwork, Love, Let.**
